office_does: The assessor values every taxable property in Lewis County each year for property taxes; taxing districts and voters set the levies.
race_blurb: Uncontested: first-term incumbent Ross W. Nielson (Prefers Republican Party) is the only candidate and submitted no voters' guide statement.

candidates.summary: First-term Lewis County Assessor and former independent fee appraiser; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Won the office in 2022 with 52.7% over Tom Crowson [S5]
Campaign says he inherited a large backlog of court and tax appeal cases and runs a 'hands-on' office [S3]
Submitted no statement to the 2026 voters' guide [S1]
